title: Yellow Dense Dutch Nduja Stew
description: A pungent and dense Dutch dish featuring nduja, perfect for midnight cravings, made with a mirepoix base and low-fat-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, cooking until the vegetables are tender.
Add the nduja to the pot, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer raw.
Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the diced potato, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the potatoes are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew until it is mostly smooth, or allow it to cool and puree it in a blender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve the stew hot.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice, if desired.
